خَاقٌ The length of a desert. (JK, TA.) ＝
-A2- الخَاقِ بَاقِ, (S, K,) or خَاقِ بَاقِ, (IB, TA,) or the latter also, without ال, (K, accord. to the TA, [but not in the CK nor in my MS. copy of the K,) The sound of the ذَكَر in the flesh of the interior of the فَرْج; (IAar, K, * TA;) or the sound of the فَرْج on the occasion of the act of نِكَاح. (IB, TA.) ―
-b2- And hence, (IB, TA,) or because of its خَوَق, i. e. width, (S, K, *) The فَرْج [or vulva, itself]. (S, IB, K.) الخَاقِ بَاقِ is indecl., with kesr for its termination, (S,) like الخَازِ بَازِ. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
